meta.name: Crackdown
meta.description:
Top agent, RP, and his team are leading the charge to neutralize India’s biggest enemies. With time running out, can our secret agents eliminate the threat before it eliminates them?

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Dead on arrival!
videos.overview: Despite accomplishing a mission, the D-O has to cover up something that might create a major upheaval in the department.

videos.title: Girl in the mirror
videos.overview: D-O has made Divya an offer she just cannot refuse. She has only two options - Join the mission or put a loved one in jeopardy!

videos.title: Take the bait
videos.overview: Divya must convince the perpetrators she's one of them. She may fail or succeed. Either way, her life is in grave danger.

videos.title: Equaliser
videos.overview: Just when the D-O thought they nipped the biggest terror conspiracy in the bud, the threat spirals out of control and enters their own home.

videos.title: Red Flag
videos.overview: The only one who survived, is he the mastermind? At the same time, the hunt for Divya begins. And Zora-war finally gets what he always wanted.

videos.title: No way out
videos.overview: Will RP's warning turn into Nation's biggest nightmare? Only time will tell. And time is what they don't have.

videos.title: De-Cipher
videos.overview: Zorawar's ego is the cause of a big tragedy… and even bigger national embarrassment. For him the only way out is RP's offer. Divya discovers the most shocking truth.

videos.title: Final Crackdown
videos.overview: Nation is under attack. Agents are running against time. Will they pull the plug just in time to save count-less lives that are at stake?

videos.title: Riyaz Meets Fawzia
videos.overview: The Prime Minister appoints a new RAW agent, Avantika Shroff to defend the National Security when an airplane gets hijacked. Meanwhile, Riyaz Pathan discovers that Preeti is in danger and contacts Fawzia for a lead. Will he succeed?

videos.title: Abu Khalil Makes His Move
videos.overview: Riyaz Pathan grows impatient when Avantika Shroff takes over his investigation and interrogates Zorawar. Meanwhile, Abu Khalil holds the passengers hostage in Afghanistan and blackmails the RAW agents to meet his demand. Will they comply?

videos.title: Garima Grows Frustrated!
videos.overview: Avantika is ordered by the defence minister to inform the media about Fawzia's arrest. Elsewhere, Garima has to execute the task given to her by Tariq to gain a safe passage out of India. Will Garima free herself?

videos.title: Preeti Escapes the Compound!
videos.overview: RP and Zorawar team up after the incident at the hospital and search for Garima. Meanwhile, Preeti is able to escape from the compound and tries to find a way back to safety. How will Khalil react to discovering this?

videos.title: Divya Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Avantika denies knowing why Khalil wants her, but RP secretly asks Max to do a background check. Things go smoothly until Garima shows up at the house and blows Divya's cover, leading to a shootout. Will Divya leave her mission?

videos.title: Is Divya in Trouble?
videos.overview: RP, Divya and Zorawar head to the airport with Garima in cuffs. Later, Divya is frisked at a remote location and taken to meet Mustafa. Will Divya land up in any major trouble at Mustafa's house?

videos.title: Khalil Reveals His Past
videos.overview: RP manages to capture Khalil in a historic joint operation between RAW and ISI. He interrogates Khalil and learns that he used to be an informer for Avantika and how he turned into a terrorist because of her betrayal. Will RP believe Khalil?

videos.title: Khalil Gets His Revenge
videos.overview: RP and Divya find out that Khalil has escaped and realise that he is going to attack Avantika at the Ministry debriefing. They reach there but fail to stop Khalil from killing Avantika. Can they capture Khalil before he causes more damage?
